# Scotty Eastwood — Dose of Courage Coaching

> 1:1 Christian business and productivity coaching. Scotty Eastwood helps faith-first Christian entrepreneurs get more results in their business and more time with their family, using the Freedom Framework. Coaching is 100% remote, worldwide.

## About
- Scotty Eastwood is a husband, father, and serial entrepreneur who has started more than 10 businesses. He is a Christian (a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints) and coaches Christian entrepreneurs, creators, and salespeople.
- Method: the Freedom Framework. Clarity (find the 20% of actions driving 80% of results), Leverage (protect them on the calendar so the same hours produce more), Courage (clear the fear or guilt underneath the stalls so you follow through).
- Positioning: not anti-work, anti-absence. Help driven people build an extraordinary life without sacrificing the people and things that make life worth living.
- Guarantee: real, provable results and time back, or your money back, or coaching continues free until you get there.
